name: delay_slapback_snare
description: Slapback echo on snare — single short echo adds size without reverb wash
notes: 80ms slapback: just long enough to sound like a room reflection, short enough to stay tight. No feedback — one echo only. LP at 8kHz darkens the echo so it sits behind the dry hit. Mix 0.2 = subtle; raise to 0.35 for a more obvious rockabilly feel. Insert mode.
